outcome: oxygen requirement at 30 days of life
cohort: The study included 810 infants (from a total of 13,471 CDH patients) born at gestational age <34 weeks with congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH), recorded in the multicenter, multinational CDH Study Group registry between 1995 and 2022.
finding: Survival rates for infants born preterm with congenital diaphragmatic hernia remain low, significantly impacted by a high rate of non-repair, although more aggressive use of extracorporeal life support and surgical repair may improve survival.
